data.title: School offers Leo a Year 3 place
data.summary: International School Beispielfeld gGmbH has offered Leo a place in Year 3 starting the new school year and encloses an enrolment agreement and fee schedule. To accept, a signed copy of the agreement must be returned to the admissions office by 6 July 2027, or the place goes to the next family on the waiting list.
data.explanation: This is a formal offer of a school place for Leo, not yet a binding contract. To accept it, both parents should sign the enclosed enrolment agreement and send one signed copy back to the admissions office by 6 July 2027. If this is not done, the school will give the place to another family on its waiting list, so act before then if you want to keep the place. Review the enclosed fee schedule carefully before signing, since it will set out the costs of attending; it may be worth checking whether any of these fees can be deducted on your tax return later.
